tools.name: cdxgen

tools.name: opengrep
tools.package_version: opengrep 2.0.0 (opengrep_linux_x86, sha256 37e93f4da5fd04a18c5c1febbdd12f7e98dfccd4d0c9cf2593bcb25eeb462da0, cosign signature verified) with the 100 cryptography rules (harness/select_rules.py, by CWE) of opengrep-rules at f1d2b562, the archived head, rule content of 0f5a85ce (2024-12-13); rule set sha256/16 f98b5696b0867c1f by harness/ruleset-digest.sh
tools.notes: Each result is a component named by its rule id, at the reported file and line. Rule-set digest recipe: sha256 over sha256sum's lines ("<sha256>  <path>") for every selected rule file, paths relative to the rule directory and sorted bytewise, first 16 hex digits (harness/ruleset-digest.sh).

tools.name: codeql
